proof_scope: The common canonical action is C^1 on the open admissible product and cap chart. Its local curvature is minus the real active-block generalized inverse quadratic form of the true marked cross-response. One active sign gives a definite curvature sign. The centered canonical marks are uniformly locally Lipschitz on a common reciprocal-floor cone. Distributional vanishing there, or on a connected domain spanning hot floors and a sequence of cold floors tending to zero, suffices for the original ordinary theta asymptotic by the inherited hot limit.

Comparing to the same holomorphic complementary completion on the nominated cold square makes the normalized action error quadratic in the height-600 residual. One-boundary monotonicity bounds each signed average correction in that order. The same action yields a weak curvature bound, and on one-sign open patches a positive integrated active marked sensitivity bound. The normalized squared saturated-column mass is quadratic for the centered cap. A two-sign repair on a true tilted row cancels both mean scales in one oriented real Hellinger integral.

The two genuine real comparisons at a hypothetical first tie imply an exact signed-square budget, including old zero factors. At least 13/1013 of the actual deficit has same-site pairwise oriented exterior caps above the stated interval-average threshold, as well as the large oriented real column. The same budget bounds signed phase and clipped-profile reconstruction from the true real log integrals.

For odd square-subgroup order b >= 1500 and sqrt(p)/b <= 18/25, either sign has a forbidden triangle or pentagon. The obstruction persists under the stated symmetric deletions for b >= 3000 and implies many rooted simple pentagons via group removal. For sufficiently large eligible b the near-optimal nonroot mass is supported up to a deficit-proportional error on characters of order at most 10^6 divisible by five, giving a strict uniform gap when 5 does not divide b. At fixed target mass, one optimizer bounds the critical candidate list and guarantees a recurrent-site obstruction if the score-minimizing admissible pin remains trapped.
